moments.author: Enes Kanter Freedom
moments.quote: I fear God and God alone. See y’all tomorrow…@WNBA
moments.why: Defying death threats ahead of WNBA Finals, his bold stand electrified fans.

moments.author: Stephen A. Smith
moments.quote: Trump: ‘I’m bringing trillions… I’m the greatest president who’s ever lived.’
moments.why: Smith’s recount of Trump’s dinner remarks—especially that ‘trillions’ line—went viral for its sheer audacity.

moments.author: Katie Zacharia
moments.quote: Unfollowed Sean Hannity hours after her disastrous week.
moments.why: A dramatic unfollow post capped a chaotic stint as White House press secretary, sparking wide reaction.

moments.author: Jan Crawford
moments.quote: I apologize … I deleted that tweet because it was a violation of CBS News standards.
moments.why: Her public mea culpa over a controversial tweet drew broad attention to media bias and standards.
